svg.title: What Co-Scientist did, what people did, and how far each case was tested
svg.desc: Schematic of the six-agent loop, self-rating versus expert rating, and a table of three laboratory cases against an evidence ladder.
svg.text: LIA / PART III / III-04 THE CO-SCIENTIST
The system forms and screens hypotheses; people set the goal, choose, and test
Co-Scientist runs a tournament among its own hypotheses. In each of the three laboratory cases, experts chose what to test and
laboratory scientists ran the experiments. No case went beyond cells, organoids or a mechanism a laboratory already held.
states a goal in ordinary language,
six specialized agents, each with its own instructions
The scientist can respond, redirect or add hypotheses of their own at any point. Criticism has two
sources: other agents arguing from their instructions, and the literature reached through search.
Each hypothesis carries an Elo rating that rises or falls with each pairwise
comparison. Across 203 research goals, hypotheses produced later in a run
scored higher. On 15 goals written by seven biomedical experts, its ratings
came to exceed other models and the experts’ own best guesses.
The rating is the system’s own, so this shows that longer runs satisfy its own
Smaller human check: experts who wrote 11 goals rated outputs
Five-point scale. Subjective assessments, not ground
THREE LABORATORY CASES, READ AGAINST HOW FAR EACH WAS TESTED
Restricted to 2,300 drugs across 34 cancer types;
3 of 5 inhibited AML cell viability in culture.
Binimetinib was active at concentrations as
low as 2 nanomolar in three of four lines.
No prior preclinical evidence in AML; no expert
KIRA6: 10 nanomolar in one AML line against
180 in the control, 18-fold. Two other AML lines
markedly less sensitive; the other two drugs
Epigenetic changes that could be targeted
in human hepatic organoids without cellular
toxicity; one, vorinostat, has US approval for a
Answer held by a laboratory, unpublished;
minimal background; two days of work
Top hypothesis, that cf-PICIs interact with
diverse phage tails to expand host range,
Single drugs chosen by experts from the system’s lists
These are in vitro results: cultured cells, a few cell lines, three independent experiments per condition. In the paper’s words, “they are not a replacement for the rigorous preclinical and
clinical assessment that is typically required for therapeutic validation.”
Sources: Gottweis et al. 2026, Accelerating scientific discovery with Co-Scientist, Nature 655; Gottweis et al. 2025, Towards an AI
co-scientist, arXiv:2502.18864. Counts of drugs, lines and concentrations as reported in the paper.
